formal: I have been a salaried graphic designer for six years, and I wish to become a full-time freelancer. I have one client secured and savings sufficient to cover approximately two months of living expenses. My plan is to resign at the end of this month and begin freelancing full time. I have long consulted you on career decisions of this kind before acting, and you have been my point of reference for years. I know what I want from my design career, and having weighed this option against remaining salaried, I have made my decision. What is your view?
